page.layout: One printed page, a title page with centred lines of text. The visible print is faint and largely show-through from the reverse side, so most lines cannot be read.
page.notes: The large capitals in the upper and middle part of the page are mirrored show-through from the other side of the leaf, and are not transcribed. The lower lines, near the foot, are very faint and may be a place and date, but they cannot be read with certainty. A handwritten or stamped mark in the upper left corner is not transcribed. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is legible.
